## Why it was silent

Two dead ends first: the eids named in the clip's own table entry (302/303/306) turn out to hit an unrelated team-bio narration table reached via TeamNameDisplayIDLookup_0041b980, live-confirmed wrong clip twice. The same data/full_event_dump.json carries a second, low-range eid (11/12/15) for the identical clip names, reachable through the same InsertDriverTableEntry pipeline — that one plays correctly. Separately, the on-track car count used the active/loaded flag (true for all 22 grid cars from session start) instead of pittingStatus (0 = on track, 4 = pit/garage, even mid pit-exit) — fixed by filtering on pittingStatus==0. A 60s global cooldown was added on top of the existing per-band once-per-session latch so count flapping across a band boundary can't fire two lines back to back.

## Rebuild

```bash
C:\msys64\mingw32\bin\gcc.exe -shared -O2 -Wall \
    -o traffic_density_commentary.dll traffic_density_commentary.c -lkernel32
```

`source.c` writes the same bytes the manifest would write to the .exe,
but into the running process at DLL attach — so no game file is
modified and not loading the DLL is the uninstall. Each site verifies
its expected original bytes first and skips on mismatch, so a different
game build is a no-op rather than a corruption.
